completeness: INCOMPLETE: workflows are configurable per tenant. Read the real list from POST /api/v1/workflows/search on connect and diff against this. Only the 14 'official' states are documented with meanings. If parcel.isReturn is true and a state maps to in_transit or pending, report returning (inferred rule).
result_rules: returned = physically back with the merchant only. returning = a return on its way back. exception = needs a person. Unlisted raw value = unknown; log it and keep the raw string. Result set: pending, in_transit, delivered, returning, returned, exception, unknown.
